description: Submit an AI video upscale task to enhance a video to 1080p, 2k, or 4k via POST https://videoupscaler.co/api/v1/upscale (powered by FlashVSR diffusion video super-resolution). Charges credits per second of video (1080p: 1/s, 2k: 2/s, 4k: 3/s) and refunds automatically if a task fails.

idempotency_key.description: Optional unique string (1-255 printable ASCII characters, e.g. a UUID) so retrying the same request never charges twice. Auto-generated if omitted.

ops.description: Optional restoration & enhancement flags: deinterlace (boolean), stabilize (boolean), denoise (0-3), deflicker (boolean), fpsMultiplier (1|2|4|8), slowMotion (boolean), faceRestore (boolean), hdr ("none"|"hdr10"|"hlg"), engine ("general"|"anime").

resolution.description: Target output resolution: "1080p" (1 credit/s), "2k" (2 credits/s), or "4k" (3 credits/s).

video_url.description: Public http(s) URL of an MP4, MOV, or WebM video (up to 500MB; up to 1200s at 1080p, 600s at 2k/4k), or the video_url returned by create_upload.

webhook_url.description: Optional public https:// URL to receive a signed POST webhook when the task completes or fails.

name: upscale_video
